component_laws.opportunities: Shared unit-mean Gamma game frailty G; draw both teams N_t|G~Poisson(G*lambda_t). Earlier fitted Gamma/Poisson priors/team rates; zero opportunities retained.

component_laws.allocation: Pass attempts split among earlier QB identities+other; destinations among receivers/other target/no-target; partially pooled earlier QB/receiver event rates assign completion/interception/incompletion. Designed runs/scrambles/kneels allocated separately with native role semantics and explicit other. Latent usage-zero is not DNP/injury status.
component_laws.constraints: Per trajectory C<=A; C+INT<=A; rec<=targets; receiver+other receptions=sum completions; player+other carries=sum designed+scramble+kneel; no arbitrary output caps.
component_laws.gain_TD: Sample qualified earlier signed event/gain tuples with declared role/team/passer pooling and sparse backoff. Same completed-catch gains/TDs credit both receiver and passer. Rush gain/TD tied to carry; missing gains not zero; no test-max clipping. Tuple/gain/TD interface qualification is required before those outputs run.
component_laws.provider_conditioning: ONE penalized moment projection: sum_j((m_j(theta)-provider_anchor_j)^2/prior_process_variance_j)+KL(theta||earlier_football_prior). Log/softmax parameters preserve event/count constraints instead of capping conflicting projections. Prior variances from earlier football, explicit one-unit positive variance prior if needed. One initialization/solver/iteration/tolerance must be code-bound before canary; failed solve is technical stop, not retry/tuning. Objective is block-factorized: core count anchors determine count parameters; conditional gain/TD anchors determine child parameters with core held fixed. Both block settings frozen once; one initialization each, no gain-result-driven rec refit.
component_laws.combined_events: rush_rec_yd=sum signed components within trajectory; anytime_td=(rushTD+recTD>=1), excludes passingTD. Exact chart-PPR blocked until all rare component/event/scoring contracts exist; never legacy PPR.
component_laws.partial_path: Record per-component availability before generation; raw shared count/event assignments retained once, child gains reuse same assignments/registered component stream if supported. An unsupported child is explicitly unavailable, never zero or a claimed complete12-target game.
